description: Creates a Stablevoy invoice the buyer pays in USDT or USDC and returns its payment link, checkoutUrl. Needs a store key (npx stablevoy-mcp login). Send that link to the buyer yourself; Stablevoy does not email it. Give a reference (for example "acme-october") whenever you can: the same amount and reference return the same invoice instead of a second one. returnUrl is an https page the buyer goes back to after paying. expiresInMinutes, 15 to 10080, is how long the buyer has; left out, the store default applies. After expiresAt the payment page tells the buyer not to pay, and money that still arrives is marked paid_late. To change the amount of an unpaid invoice, cancel it with cancel_invoice first. Check the result later with get_invoice. Pass store when several stores are connected. A failure comes back as an error with its code and what to do, for example rate_limited with the seconds to wait.

amountUsd.description: Amount in US dollars as a decimal string, for example "250" or "19.99".

expiresInMinutes.description: How long the buyer has to pay, 15 to 10080 minutes; leave it out for the store default. Use a day or more for an invoice sent by email.

reference.description: Your reference for this invoice, sent back in webhooks, 1 to 200 characters.

returnUrl.description: https address the buyer returns to after paying.

store.description: Store id or exact store name from list_stores. Needed only when several stores are connected.

name: create_invoice
title: Create an invoice
